provenance.source: Kenney Interface Sounds, downloaded from https://kenney.nl/assets/interface-sounds on 2026-09-23
provenance.note: source/ogg/ holds every file under the archive's Audio/ directory unchanged. LICENSE.txt is the archive's License.txt unchanged. The preview clip and the two .url shortcuts are not assets and were left out.

derivation.note: Kenney ships Ogg Vorbis only, and Vega OS cannot play Vorbis. MP3 is transcoded from the verbatim OGG at the same sample rate and channel count, 192 kbit/s CBR like the JDSherbert exports. Deterministic with this encoder build. Each derived export records its own SHA-256 here, so re-encoding is a visible change to this file rather than a silent one; a re-encode on another machine is not expected to match byte for byte.
